text: 美国国债收益率飙升并触及数十年高位，正威胁到今年以来备受新兴市场投资者青睐的套息交易策略。 花旗集团已关闭其套息交易组合，该组合此前包括做多南非兰特、墨西哥比索、哥伦比亚比索和土耳其里拉，同时做空加元和瑞郎。花旗在周四发布的一份研报中表示，此举是由于强劲的美国采购经理人指数（PMI）报告、疲弱的5年期美债拍卖以及地缘政治消息共同推高了市场波动。 分析师写道：“我们过去已多次证明，套息交易通常在波动率高企和交易拥挤时期表现不佳。”
text_en: The surge in U.S. Treasury yields to multi-decade highs is threatening the carry trade strategy that has been favored by emerging market investors this year. Citigroup has closed its carry trade portfolio, which previously included long positions in the South African rand, Mexican peso, Colombian peso, and Turkish lira, while shorting the Canadian dollar and Swiss franc. Citigroup said in a research note released on Thursday that the move was due to a strong U.S. PMI report, a weak 5-year Treasury auction, and geopolitical news that together drove up market volatility. Analysts wrote: "We have proven many times in the past that carry trades usually perform poorly during periods of high volatility and crowded positioning."
